t: This is the Royal Tank Regiment Memorial in Whitehall Court, a sculpture commemorating the Royal Tank Regiment. It was made by Vivien Mallock, an English sculptor who works mainly in bronze. Her career began at the Museum of Army Flying in Hampshire, where she sculpted celebrated Second World War fighter pilots, including John Cunningham, to mark the fiftieth anniversary of the Battle of Britain. She became an associate of the Royal British Society of Sculptors in 1998.
